prompts.heritage: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game texture atlas for Bard, not a presentation. Make exactly 8 separate square trade-emblem tiles in a mathematically regular 4-column by 2-row grid, 2048x1024 canvas, each square tile the same size. Transparent background in every tile. No captions, lettering, numbers, mockup wall, hanging chains or perspective. All emblems strictly straight-on orthographic, centered in their own cell within the central 78%, ample empty transparent gutter, never overlap or cross cell edges. Order left-to-right top row then bottom row: 1 bread loaf and wheat; 2 anvil and hammer; 3 potion bottle and medicinal leaves; 4 welcoming lantern and crescent moon; 5 lute and ribbon; 6 needle and thread spool; 7 two fish and waves; 8 balanced market scales and a small basket. Original trade imagery, no existing logos. Fine, convincing material detail but strong silhouettes legible when reduced to 128 pixels. No words or pseudo-text. Primary request: exquisitely hand-carved medieval guild sign medallions. Warm walnut, oak and aged cedar, deep sculptural relief, flowing acanthus, chamfered edges, restrained worn gold leaf and hand-painted forest green/oxblood/milk paint accents. Each emblem has a distinctive shaped wooden silhouette, not eight identical circles. Craftspeople's chisel marks, grain that follows the carving, weather-smoothed high points, small burnished details; cared-for heirlooms that invite loyal customers, not rotten props. Neutral soft diffuse lighting, subtle intrinsic relief only; no harsh baked directional shadow.

prompts.orbital: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original science-fiction game decal texture atlas for Bard. Exactly eight emblem-only decals in a precise 4-column, 2-row grid on a transparent 2048x1024 canvas. Every emblem centered inside its equal square cell with 12 percent clear margins, no overlapping cells. All straight-on flat artwork, no perspective, no shadows, no words, numbers or pseudo-writing. Eight very distinct invented lunar-colony service insignia: top row hydroponic wheat sprig within an orbital ring; crossed repair spanner and hex bolt; botanical medical vial; habitat dome under a crescent. Bottom row wave-form musical oscillator; woven technical fiber spool; water droplet with filtration rings; cargo crate and orbital transit arcs. Style: beautifully designed premium aerospace equipment decals, geometric modular graphic design, subtle screen-print texture on matte ceramic-white, deep midnight navy, warm signal orange and limited mint green. Carefully crafted original insignia, varied round/hexagonal/rounded rectangular silhouettes, two-tone schematic detail, fine secondary linework but strong readable symbol. Elegant practical human colony design, not generic glowing neon HUD, not medieval wood, no existing brands. Preserve actual alpha transparency.
prompts.commerce: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production contemporary retail game texture atlas, eight original pictorial brand marks. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, equal square cells on a 2048x1024 TRANSPARENT background; every emblem strictly inside the central 80% of its cell. No text, letters, numbers, border labels or words. Flat front-facing screen-printed art, no shadows or perspective. TOP ROW left to right: modern smartphone with a small signal arc in a bold rounded mint/navy badge; independent wireless network emblem of three broadcast arcs over a globe in cobalt and cream; beautifully drawn roasted coffee beans and a steaming cup in ochre/espresso/cream; fresh milk carton and pastoral sun in sky blue/cream. BOTTOM ROW: golden oat cereal bowl with wheat in golden yellow and navy; curled pasta and vine tomato in tomato red/cream; citrus and orchard fruit in vivid forest green/coral; a household cleaning spray bottle and soap bubbles in lavender/navy/cream. Original premium fictional independent brands, sophisticated illustrative packaging identity, beautiful graphic negative space, varied die-cut outlines, sharp commercially legible forms, restrained tactile print grain and tiny paper edge imperfections. Intended for actual product cartons and storefront banners in a modern game, so strong visual categorization matters. No medieval heraldry, no game UI, no logos belonging to real companies.
prompts.consumer:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production raster texture atlas for fictional consumer brands in a video game. Create a genuinely transparent landscape 2:1 canvas, exactly four equal square columns and two equal square rows, eight independent brand identities centered in their cells with 12 percent safe margins. Absolutely no grid lines or cell backgrounds. Unlike collectible stickers, these are confident real consumer product wordmarks: no enclosing borders, badges, medallions, shields, die-cut outlines, drop shadows, embossing, 3D, faux vintage grain or generic decorative flourishes. Flat ink, restrained asymmetry, distinctive custom typography with one small idea integrated into each wordmark. Make each brand look art-directed by a different human designer, not eight similar logos.
Top row from left to right:
1 exact text "morrow" lowercase rounded cobalt blue sans, the final o broken by a tiny coral signal notch. Fictional phone/network brand.
2 exact text "LOOP" tall narrow near-black grotesk, one lime green line threading through the two O's. Fictional internet service brand.
3 exact text "DAYBREAK" warm brick red loose but highly legible condensed capitals, tiny sunrise dot tucked above the A. Coffee brand.
4 exact text "plain" deep indigo elegant low-contrast lowercase serif, a single small blue milk-drop dot. Dairy brand.
Bottom row:
5 exact text "OAT & CO." honest dark brown sturdy typographic wordmark, a single golden oat stroke rising beside the O. Pantry cereal.
6 exact text "POMIERO" tomato red bold expressive serif lettering, one spare green stem accent over the I. Pasta/pantry brand.
7 exact text "little orchard" leaf green handwritten monoline lowercase, one simple orange fruit dot hanging off a letter. Fruit brand.
8 exact text "tidy" blue unpretentious heavy lowercase sans, one yellow four-point sparkle replacing the dot of i. Household supplies.
All lettering must be accurate and readable. Empty transparent negative space around each wordmark. No extra text, no mockups, no products, no slogans. Strong and simple enough for small packaging and distant store banners. Use natural irregularity in the handwritten mark only; do not make the entire sheet scruffy.
